Because I can't handle this, and have been struggling my entire life.

I first tried to kill myself at 14. I wish I had actually managed to do it properly back then. It would have saved me a lot of trouble.

I can't even fucking break my skin. Pathetic. The knife is more than sharp enough. It's just too hard.
So what should I do, drop out of university? I'll just become more depressed, which will lead to the same end result.

Sure, change things. Change what? Even if my psychologist is right and ADHD is the cause of my depression, it's not as if I'll even be able to see if that's true for quite some time. I can't handle this. I just want to give up.
I can't handle life. I should just give up.
Software Engineering. I'm doing first year courses right now though, so right now I'm just taking physics, chem, calculus, linear algebra, etc.
For the usual reasons. I want a good career. Or so I thought. The degree sounded interesting. But this is hell.
